verdict.rationale: Apify provides a CLI scaffold (`apify create my-first-actor`), reusable base Docker images, toolkits for new Actors, and a large marketplace/Store of 64,279 ready-made Actors that can be run or forked immediately, closely matching the 'start building immediately' story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a curated template gallery UI and independent hands-on review confirming ease of starting from a template.
